LanguageData.SB_CommandSharedDesc: Make this a shared bed. Shared beds have no permanent owner: colonists without a bed of their own claim it when they go to sleep and release it when they wake up.\n\nLovers will join each other in shared beds with free slots.
LanguageData.SB_Setting_PreferShared: Prefer shared beds over unowned normal beds
LanguageData.SB_Setting_PreferSharedDesc: Colonists without a bed use a free shared bed before permanently claiming an unowned normal bed.
LanguageData.SB_Setting_DebuffDesc: Mood effect for one day after sleeping in a shared bed while having no bed of their own. 0 disables it.
LanguageData.SB_Setting_AlertFactor: Colonists per shared sleeping slot (for the "need colonist beds" alert): {0}
